nodes.speaker: deshawn
nodes.text: Hey. Grandpa says I owe you one. I'm paying it. Come look.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Under the Pruitts' back porch: a buried concrete cistern from the 1940s. Sealed lid. Clean water. Hundreds of gallons.

nodes.speaker: deshawn
nodes.text: Ash can't get in. Grandpa says his dad dug it in the war. We share it. Everyone on the block. You tell people.
